description: Renovate only updates GitHub Actions, on a schedule (the _update-github-actions Claude skill is the on-demand equivalent), and merges them into main without a PR once CI passes on the renovate/* branch. Every action is pinned to a commit hash with its release in a comment. npm dependencies and agent skills are updated by the update-dependencies workflow.

packageRules.description: anthropics/claude-code-action is released almost daily. In the shared group, it would change the branch on most runs, and a branch that changed during a run is not merged by that run: the other updates would wait behind it. It has its own group, which is merged on the days that follow a day without a release.
